timelineEvents.title: Róża Etkin performs Kaper’s Sonatina in Berlin
timelineEvents.label: 1927 · Etkin performs Sonatina
timelineEvents.shortDescription: Róża Etkin performs Kaper’s Sonatina in Berlin, a performance later confirmed by Kaper’s oral-history recollection.
timelineEvents.longDescription: A 1927 German press notice documents the Berlin performance context, and Kaper’s later oral-history recollection identifies the work as his Sonatina.

places.authorizedName: Bach-Saal / former Blüthner-Saal, Lützowstraße 76 / Genthiner Straße 11 (today Genthiner Straße 26), Berlin-Tiergarten
places.publicNote: Berlin concert venue where Róża Etkin gave a recital on 3 December 1927 that included the first performance of a work by B. Kaper. The venue is identifiable with the former Blüthner-Saal, renamed Bach-Saal after renovation in autumn 1927, in the Klindworth-Scharwenka / Schwalm hall complex at Lützowstraße 76 / Genthiner Straße. The marker represents the documented complex rather than a reconstructed footprint of the individual hall.
